about_the_game:
Overheat is a factory-rouge-like game. In this game, players are not building huge and complex factories, but short and concise assembly lines. Improve the performance of your buildings by matching different building plugins or create unique effects to cope with the increasing pressure of enemy attacks for fifteen days until victory.

About the factory pipelines

You can build various buildings on the map, form a variety of production lines to meet the needs of your base's defense. As you progress through the levels, you'll be able to expand your buildable areas and gradually develop your own unique building layout.

About the plugins

Every day you can buy various plugins. Plugins can provide unique effects to a certain type of building, and even reverse the defense of the entire base. Different plugins can form synergies and link with terrain.

About enemies and challenges

As you progress through the game, you'll face a variety of challenges: "airdrops" to break through the player's defenses, "surprise attacks" to concentrate your efforts, and so on...... In addition, when you develop your base, you will also increase the "threat value", and a higher threat value means that you have to make trade-offs and choices in various enemy enhancements.

About the future of this game

Our game is still in development, with new characters, new plugins, and new enemies, as well as a lot of experience improvements and stat balancing. The game will be officially released only when it is developed to a level that we consider satisfactory. In short, welcome to join the QQ group 831346143 to communicate and experience!
